subject: PlaneGeometry
question:
A coin with diameter $1 \mathrm{~cm}$ rolls around the outside of a regular hexagon with edges of length $1 \mathrm{~cm}$ until it returns to its original position. In centimetres, what is the length of the path traced out by the centre of the coin? <image1>
Choices:
A:$6+\pi / 2$
B:$12+\pi$
C:$6+\pi$
D:$12+2 \pi$
E:$6+2 \pi$
